Career Overview: Vera Wang was hired as an editor at Vogue immediately upon graduation from Sarah Lawrence College, making her the youngest editor at that magazine. She stayed at Vogue for 17 years before leaving in 1987 to join Ralph Lauren, where she worked for two years.
